from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowData(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric entry extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the document belongs to")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name (e.g., 'Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities')")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The reporting year (e.g., '2022', '2023')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported monetary amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_data_points: list[CashFlowData]
